page_title: PIS 0-0 VER | Pisa v Verona 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Yellow card! It's like Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Marco Guida agrees and books him.
90+5' Unai Nunez (Verona) picks up a yellow card.
90+4' Martin Frese (Verona) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
90+3' Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
88' Martin Frese (Verona) is given a yellow card.
87' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) earns the yellow card.
86' Martin Frese (Verona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
85' Substitution. Suat Serdar (Verona) makes his way off the pitch and Yellu Santiago comes on as his replacement.
83' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
81' The resulting corner from Martin Frese (Verona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
79' Substitution. Stefano Moreo makes way for Matteo Tramoni (Pisa).
78' Booking. Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) receives a caution from the referee.
77' The Pisa players are exchanging some short passes.
73' Martin Frese (Verona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
72' Martin Frese (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

71' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Guida blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Pisa.

69' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
69' Martin Frese (Verona) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
67' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) replaces Giovane.
67' Gift Orban comes off the pitch to be replaced by Amin Sarr (Verona).
66' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabriele Piccinini is coming onto the pitch as Marius Marin (Pisa) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' Substitution. Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) on for Samuele Angori.
65' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris and he is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).
65' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) picks up a yellow card.
63' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) sends a long ball in, but Lorenzo Montipo comfortably gathers the ball.
61' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Fallou Cham is replaced by Rafik Belghali (Verona).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) comes onto the pitch for Antoine Bernede.
59' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Guida signals.
58' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
55' A cross into the box picks out Gift Orban (Verona), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
55' Giovane (Verona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
51' Samuele Angori (Pisa) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
51' Marco Guida blows the whistle, Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is penalised for a foul.
49' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Verona.
47' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Fallou Cham (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Lorenzo Montipo into a superb diving save to keep it out.
42' Gift Orban (Verona) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
39' Pisa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
37' Verona fail to score from a corner as Adrian Semper (Pisa) leaps to collect the ball.
35' Giovane (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Martin Frese (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Guida blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
32' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
32' Now Pisa have a corner.
29' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.

28' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) has a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better as his effort ends wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
27' Great teamplay by Pisa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Verona.
22' Fallou Cham (Verona) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
21' Giovane (Verona) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
19' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
18' Pisa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Samuele Angori (Pisa) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Pisa. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Pisa.
15' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out for a corner. Pisa can continue in their attacking effort.
14' Samuele Angori (Pisa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball has crossed the sideline. Pisa are taking a throw-in.
12' The corner from Martin Frese (Verona) is cleared away by the defence.
12' Giovane (Verona) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and Verona will have a corner.
10' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' The linesman signals that Giovane (Verona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicolas Valentini (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. Verona will have a throw-in.
3' Unai Nunez (Verona) makes a slide tackle, but referee Marco Guida blows for a foul. Pisa have a free kick.
2' Antoine Bernede (Verona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Pisa will kick-off.
Marco Guida was nominated as the referee for this game.
